summary: This note describes Sant Martí d'Empúries, an entity (a locality or settlement unit) within the town of L'Escala, located next to the ruins of Empúries, also called Empòrion. The ancient Greeks established the settlement in the 6th century BC. It served as the county seat until 1079, when the seat moved to Castelló d'Empúries, a place less exposed to attack.
one_line: Sant Martí d'Empúries is a locality within L'Escala, beside the ancient Greek ruins of Empúries, which was the county seat until 1079.
key_facts: Sant Martí d'Empúries is an entity of the town of L'Escala.
Sant Martí d'Empúries is located next to the ruins of Empúries or Empòrion.
Ancient Greeks established the settlement of Empúries in the 6th century BC.
Sant Martí d'Empúries was the county seat until 1079.
In 1079 the county seat moved from Sant Martí d'Empúries to Castelló d'Empúries.
The seat moved to Castelló d'Empúries because it was a place less exposed to attack.
